label: preparing
what: A coordinated gathering or meal in the great hall, probably connected to tomorrow's 18:00 appointment with the innkeeper. Twenty-four loaves have been delivered, materials and lanterns exchanged, and freight and innkeeper coordinate supplies. The request not to arrive early and unspecified purpose suggest a concealed event, possibly a surprise for me, but its exact purpose is not established. Neighbour offered baking help; secretary knows of supplies and handles the appointment, though their knowledge of the full plan is uncertain.
